verdict.rationale: The skill uses the open Agent Skills format (a SKILL.md folder) and claims to work in any agent that supports skills. It documents installation via Claude Code plugin marketplace commands, copying the folder into a skills directory, and uploading a zip under Settings → Capabilities → Skills. However, the only harness-specific instructions are for Claude; cross-agent portability rests on a generic format claim. missing for 10: named per-harness install instructions for Codex, Cursor and other agents, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works outside Claude.
